name: dispatch_numeric_format_handler
description: Skips an optional minus sign, leading digits, a decimal point with its digits and an 'l' modifier in a character string, then searches a nine-entry table for the next character and calls the matching handler, returning its result or zero when nothing matches.

name: emit_padded_text_field
description: Writes one text field into an output buffer: fills with a pad character before or after copying characters from a source string depending on a justification flag, optionally adds a sign, then stores the advanced buffer pointer and returns the count plus one.

name: emit_padded_text_field
description: Writes one text field into an output buffer: fills with a pad character before or after copying characters from a source string depending on a justification flag, optionally adds a sign, then stores the advanced buffer pointer and returns the count plus one.

name: emit_padded_text_field
description: Writes one text field into an output buffer, padding with a fill character around copied source characters according to a justification flag, and stores the new buffer position before returning a count plus one.

name: write_fill_run_count
description: Writes a run of fill characters into the output buffer for a count held in the frame, stores the buffer position through a frame pointer, and returns a counter from the frame plus one.

name: write_fill_then_copy_chars
description: Writes a run of fill characters followed by a run of characters copied from a source string into the output buffer, stores the new buffer position through a frame pointer, and returns a counter plus one.

name: copy_source_chars_to_buffer
description: Copies a counted run of characters from a source string into the output buffer, stores the new buffer position through a frame pointer, and returns a counter from the frame plus one.

name: copy_value_and_increment_counter
description: Stores a value from a stack slot through a pointer held in the frame, then returns a counter from the frame plus one; it performs only that store and that increment.

name: format_scientific_number_field
description: Formats a number in exponent notation into the output buffer: writes a sign, leading digits, a decimal point and fraction digits, then an 'E' marker with a signed exponent of up to three digits, returning the advanced buffer position.

name: format_scientific_number_field
description: Formats a number in exponent notation with a precision set from the frame: writes the sign, digits, decimal point, fraction digits and an 'E' marker with a signed exponent, then returns the advanced buffer position.

name: compute_and_pad_numeric_field
description: Computes the character width of a numeric field from the digit count, precision and an exponent length adjustment, then writes the pad characters and sign before the digits and returns the advanced count.

name: compute_exponent_field_width
description: Works out the printed width of an exponent field by adding one or two extra characters for exponents above two and three digits, then writes padding and the remaining field text into the buffer.

name: pad_and_write_exponent_field
description: Measures an exponent value by its magnitude to size the field, then writes fill characters and copies the exponent text, returning the advanced buffer position plus one.

name: write_scientific_exponent_suffix
description: Writes the 'E' marker and a sign for a scientific-notation field, then emits a fixed run of eleven digits by repeatedly calling a conversion helper, keeping the digits after the first non-zero one.

name: emit_digits_and_trailing_fill
description: Writes zero or source digits into the buffer for a count from the frame, then appends fill characters while the remaining width allows, storing the new buffer position and returning a count plus one.

name: emit_leading_zero_fill
description: Writes a leading zero, then the remaining digits and a trailing fill run into the buffer, storing the buffer position and returning a counter plus one.

name: emit_fixed_point_digits
description: Writes the integer digits of a fixed-point value, adds a decimal point when a precision is set, emits the fraction digits and then any trailing fill, returning the count plus one.

name: emit_fixed_point_zero_lead
description: Writes a zero, then fraction digits from a counter that shrinks toward zero, adds a decimal point and trailing fill when needed, and returns the count plus one.

name: emit_decimal_fraction_digits
description: Writes a decimal point when the precision is nonzero, emits the fraction digits from the source or zero characters, then adds trailing fill, storing the buffer position and returning a counter plus one.

name: emit_zero_and_fraction_fill
description: Writes a single zero character followed by fraction digits and a trailing fill run into the output buffer, then returns the buffer position count plus one.

name: emit_scientific_mantissa_and_exponent
description: Writes a zero integer digit, a decimal point and fraction digits, then an 'E' marker, a sign and a fixed run of eleven exponent digits into the output buffer, returning the buffer position plus one.

name: emit_zero_led_scientific_field
description: Writes a zero and a decimal point, then fraction digits, then an 'E' marker with a sign and a run of eleven exponent digits, returning the advanced buffer position plus one.

name: emit_zero_scientific_fill
description: Writes a zero digit, then the 'E' marker, a sign and eleven exponent digits, and appends trailing fill characters when the field flag is set, returning the buffer position plus one.

name: emit_exponent_digits_with_fill
description: Writes the 'E' marker and sign of a scientific-notation field, emits eleven exponent digits through a conversion helper, then appends fill characters when required, returning the buffer position plus one.

name: emit_plus_digits_fill
description: Writes a plus sign, then eleven digits converted by a helper, then optional fill characters into the output buffer, returning the buffer position plus one.

name: write_optional_fill_count
description: Copies a run of fill characters into the output buffer only when a field flag is set, stores the new buffer position through a frame pointer, and returns a counter plus one.

name: copy_value_and_increment_counter
description: Stores a value from a stack slot through a pointer held in the frame, then returns a counter from the frame plus one; it performs only that store and that increment.

name: count_string_bytes
description: Scans forward from a pointer byte by byte until it reaches a zero byte, counting the bytes examined, and returns that count as the length of the string.

name: generate_decimal_digits_scaled
description: Repeatedly scales a multi-word value by ten using a helper, writes a digit for each step into a buffer and tracks a decimal exponent in a state record, then records the digit count and returns.

name: adjust_decimal_scale_exponent
description: Loops over a scale exponent stored in a state record, shifting the value by powers of ten through a helper and decrementing or incrementing the exponent until it reaches the target range.

name: scale_value_toward_decimal_range
description: Repeatedly multiplies or divides a value by ten through a helper until its decimal exponent falls within range, adjusting the stored exponent field on each step.

name: emit_digits_with_scale_adjust
description: Emits decimal digits from a value into the output buffer, adjusting the scale exponent in the state record after each digit and multiplying the remaining value by ten through a helper.

name: round_and_carry_decimal_digits
description: Pads the digit buffer with zero characters up to a fixed width, then adds one to the last digit and propagates any carry through the earlier digits when rounding up.

name: emit_digit_run_carry
description: Writes a run of decimal digits into the output buffer, computing each digit from a value and a carry, and stops when the buffer width limit is reached.

name: decrement_loop_until_zero
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in a loop until it reaches zero and then returns, doing no other work.

name: multiply_64bit_by_ten
description: Multiplies a 64-bit value held in two 32-bit registers by ten, returning the high word from the upper input and carry bits and the low word as the lower input times ten.

name: shift_bits_into_decimal_digits
description: Shifts a 64-bit value left one bit at a time for a fixed count of 64 steps, carrying each bit into a decimal digit accumulator and subtracting ten with a carry into the high word whenever the digit exceeds nine.

name: parse_leading_zeros_and_sign
description: Skips leading zero characters in a number string, setting a nonzero-digit flag in the state record, then records a minus sign as a negative flag and starts the digit parsing loop.

name: parse_number_digits_and_exponent
description: Reads digits, a decimal point and exponent marker from a number string, updating the state record's digit count, fraction count and exponent sign flags, and returns when the text ends.

name: accumulate_decimal_mantissa_digit
description: Multiplies the running 16-bit mantissa by ten using shifts and adds, adds the current digit, and divides by two while the mantissa exceeds a fixed limit, keeping the value normalized.

name: parse_fraction_digits_and_exponent
description: Reads fraction digits after a decimal point and then an exponent with an optional sign from a number string, accumulating the mantissa and updating the decimal exponent in the state record.

name: finish_parsed_decimal_value
description: Applies the parsed exponent to the stored mantissa with its sign, handles zero and nonzero cases by storing either zero or the scaled value into the result record, and returns the buffer pointer.

name: normalize_and_store_float_value
description: Checks a nonzero flag in the state record and, when it is set, shifts a 64-bit value left until its top bit is set while adjusting the exponent, then stores the mantissa and exponent; otherwise stores zero.

name: normalize_and_store_nonzero_float
description: Applies a sign to the state record's exponent, shifts a 64-bit value left until its top bit is set while adjusting the exponent, then stores the normalized mantissa and exponent in the result record.

name: scale_float_exponent_to_zero
description: Loops while a decimal exponent in the state record is nonzero, multiplying or dividing the 64-bit value by ten through a helper and adjusting the exponent each step, then stores the result and sets a completion flag.

name: scale_float_exponent_and_store
description: Repeatedly shifts a 64-bit value and adjusts the decimal exponent in the state record until the exponent is zero, then stores the value into the result record and sets a completion flag.

name: store_value_set_done
description: Stores a 64-bit value through a result pointer held in the frame and sets the done flag in the result record to one.

name: call_output_handler_and_countdown
description: If a flag is set in the state record, clears it and returns; otherwise calls a handler through a stored function pointer, stores its 16-bit result, decrements a counter, and sets a completion bit in the status word when the counter reaches zero.

name: call_output_handler_and_countdown
description: Calls a handler through a stored function pointer, stores its 16-bit result in the output record, decrements a counter in the state record, and sets a completion bit in the status word when the counter reaches zero.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing: returns at once without touching memory or registers, leaving the caller unchanged.

name: round_trip_value_through_helper
description: Calls a helper in mode zero with the address of a local slot, makes two further helper calls, stores a register value into the slot, calls the helper again in mode one, and returns the slot's value.

name: call_helper_in_mode_one
description: Calls a helper with mode one and the address of a stack slot, then returns; it passes the slot address without reading or writing it.

name: transfer_global_word_by_direction
description: Either stores a global 32-bit word into the caller's pointer when the direction flag is zero, or loads the caller's 32-bit value into the global word otherwise, then returns.

name: store_pointer_value_global
description: Dereferences a pointer held in the frame and stores the 32-bit value it points to into a global word, then returns.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Walks a command string, skipping whitespace, recording the start of each quoted or unquoted argument into a global table of up to thirty-two entries, and stopping at the end of the string.

name: format_numeric_label_text
description: Chooses a set of digit characters by a switch on a numeric size and writes them into a global text buffer, calling a formatting helper to finish the label text.

name: fill_fixed_rectangle_pen3
description: Sets the drawing pen of the window's rastport to pen three and fills the fixed rectangle spanning x 247 to 316 and y 156 to 186 using Intuition graphics calls.

name: open_fill_area_window
description: Opens a fixed-size Intuition window, sets up an area-fill buffer and an allocated raster for area drawing, and calls a helper with an error code if the window or raster cannot be created.

name: draw_percentage_progress_screen
description: Opens the display window with its area and temporary raster setup, then draws the percentage labels from 20 to 100 percent and a progress frame using Intuition move, text and rectangle calls.

name: draw_labeled_status_row
description: Fills a rectangle with a pen from the frame, sets the back pen, then loops over a series of cells, moving the cursor and writing each label's text with Intuition graphics calls.

name: run_window_event_loop
description: Repeatedly polls two window message ports, bringing the screen to front when neither has a message, and dispatches received messages until a close flag is set, then frees the raster and closes the window and returns the status byte.

name: dispatch_window_idcmp_messages
description: Replies to each queued window message, records the message class and set-flag bits for the close-window code and other events, then fetches the next message from the port.

name: drain_messages_then_close_window
description: Continues to reply to pending window messages from the port while the exit flag is clear, then frees the raster and closes the window before returning the status byte.

name: free_raster_and_close_window
description: Frees the allocated raster buffer and closes the Intuition window, then returns the status byte stored in the frame.

name: format_unsigned_decimal_text
description: Converts an unsigned value into up to eleven decimal digit characters in a stack buffer, pads the result to a minimum width when it is shorter, copies the characters into the destination and zero-terminates it, returning the length.

name: format_decimal_digits_at_offset
description: Converts a value into decimal digits in a stack buffer, copies the digits into the destination at a computed offset, and returns after zero-terminating the string.

name: terminate_string_at_position
description: Stores a zero byte at the current position in the destination string, ending the string at that point.

name: divide_unsigned_by_shift_subtract
description: Divides an unsigned 32-bit dividend by a divisor using a thirty-two step shift-and-subtract loop, returning the quotient and returning zero when either operand is zero.

name: return_zero_value
description: Returns a zero 64-bit result with no other effect.

name: stub_return_immediately
description: Does nothing: returns at once without touching memory or registers, leaving the caller unchanged.

name: multiply_32bit_partial_products
description: Multiplies two 32-bit operands by combining the low and high 16-bit halves as partial products, shifting and summing them into a 64-bit result returned in two registers.

name: store_param_to_global
description: Copies its single 32-bit argument into a global variable and returns, performing no other operation.

name: normalize_integer_to_float_mantissa
description: Drops the sign bit of a 32-bit integer and, if any magnitude bits remain, shifts them through a register pair ten times to form a normalized mantissa with its top bit set; otherwise returns zero.

name: shift_sign_bits_to_result
description: Shifts a value left ten times, collecting the bit shifted out at each step into a result register, then returns that result with its top bit set.

name: pack_double_exponent_and_mantissa
description: Normalizes a 64-bit mantissa, adds the double-precision bias of 1023 to the exponent, reports underflow or overflow to a status helper when the exponent is out of range, and otherwise packs the sign, exponent and mantissa into the result.

name: pack_double_with_offset_exponent
description: Shifts a 64-bit mantissa into normalized form, computes a biased exponent by adding 1022, reports underflow or overflow when out of range, and packs the sign, exponent and fraction bits into a double-precision result.

name: report_error_return_zero
description: Calls the status reporter with code one to flag a range error, then returns a zero 64-bit result.

name: report_overflow_return_double_infinity
description: Calls the status reporter with code two to flag an overflow, then returns a double-precision infinity whose sign comes from the high word of the input.

name: sign_extend_and_shift_left
description: Returns zero when the low 31 bits of the input are zero; otherwise shifts the input left eight bits and sets the top bit.

name: normalize_single_float_exponent
description: Shifts a 32-bit magnitude until its leading bit reaches the top of the fraction field, computes a biased single-precision exponent and reports underflow or overflow to a status helper when it is out of range.

name: pack_single_float_fields
description: Shifts a 32-bit mantissa into normalized form, computes a biased exponent with an offset of 126, reports range errors, and packs the sign, exponent and fraction into a single-precision result, returning a signed infinity on overflow.

name: report_error_return_zero
description: Calls the status reporter with code one to flag a range error, then returns zero.

name: report_overflow_return_single_infinity
description: Calls the status reporter with code two to flag an overflow, then returns a single-precision infinity whose sign comes from the input.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Walks a command string, skipping whitespace, recording the start of each quoted or unquoted argument into a global table of up to thirty-two entries, and stopping at the end of the string.

name: call_routine_twice
description: Calls the same routine two times in succession and returns, with no other work between the calls.

name: load_executable_hunk_segments
description: Program entry for a port handler: fills in a segment descriptor table from hunk addresses and sizes, stores segment base pointers, and compares hunk type codes to drive the loading and relocation steps.

name: initialize_ram_handler_segments
description: Program entry for a RAM handler: zeroes a range of longwords, records the segment address in a table, and sets up the segment list before handing control on.

name: setup_process_and_directory_context
description: Looks up the current process, saves its task pointer and the current directory, opens the file it needs through library calls, and returns the resulting status after setting the globals.

name: release_handles_and_reply_port
description: Releases any open handles through library calls when they are held, frees the message port, closes the library, and returns the caller's parameter.

name: invoke_two_library_functions
description: Calls two library function vectors located at fixed negative offsets from the frame pointer, one after the other, and returns.

name: open_dos_library_or_fail
description: Opens the DOS library, returns its base when the open succeeds, and otherwise runs the cleanup path and returns the error code one hundred.

name: call_library_allocmem_vector
description: Calls the allocation vector of the library whose base is stored in a global, then returns the result.

name: call_exec_freemem_vector
description: Calls the library's free-memory vector through the library base kept in a global, returning whatever that call returns.

name: call_exec_findtask_vector
description: Calls the library's find-task vector through the library base kept in a global and returns, passing back the task pointer.

name: call_exec_setsignal_vector
description: Calls the library's set-signal vector through the library base kept in a global and returns.

name: call_exec_addport_vector
description: Calls the library's add-port vector through the library base kept in a global and returns.

name: call_exec_remport_vector
description: Calls the library's remove-port vector through the library base kept in a global and returns.

name: call_exec_checkio_vector
description: Calls the library's check-I/O vector through the library base kept in a global and returns.

name: split_quoted_tokens_into_table
description: Splits a command string into up to thirty-two tokens separated by spaces or quoted strings, stores a pointer to each token in a table, and reports an error when a quoted string is not terminated.

name: allocate_and_init_block
description: Allocates a memory block sized to the request plus twelve bytes, stores the requested size inside the block, passes the block to a helper with a global variable, and returns the address just past the block header.

name: return_result_or_minus_one
description: Calls a helper with its argument and returns that result when it is nonzero; when the helper returns zero, returns minus one instead.

name: return_minus_one
description: Returns the value minus one, all bits set, with no other effect; the routine is never reached in the decoded flow.

name: free_linked_memory_blocks
description: Walks a singly linked list whose head is held in a global variable, freeing each node with the size stored in that node and following its next pointer until the list ends.

name: insert_node_into_linked_list
description: Inserts a node after the list tail stored in the first argument's second word, sets the node's back link, and updates the head word when the list was empty.

name: expand_format_string
description: Copies a format string into a destination buffer through a pointer kept in a global variable, writing doubled percent signs as single characters, dispatching other percent sequences to a conversion routine, and flushing through a helper when the buffer is full.

name: fill_global_table_entries
description: Stores twenty values returned by a helper into consecutive entries of a global table, calls a helper once for each index up to a stored count, and then calls a final helper with its two arguments.

name: copy_string_to_offset
description: Calls a helper with the first argument to get an offset, copies a null-terminated string into the buffer at that offset, and returns the first argument unchanged.

name: copy_string_to_buffer
description: Computes a destination inside a buffer from a helper's result, copies bytes from a source string until a null byte or a length limit is reached, writes a terminating null, and returns the first argument unchanged.

name: call_dos_open_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's open function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_close_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's close function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_read_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's read function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_write_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's write function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_input_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's input-handle function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_output_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's output-handle function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_seek_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's seek function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_deletefile_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's delete-file function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_rename_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's rename function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_dos_delay_vector
description: Calls the DOS library's delay function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: run_user_identification_screen
description: Opens a custom screen and window, adds gadgets and a pointer, then shows the identification prompts, node report lines and continue, cancel and new-user choices, looping on window messages until a selection is made and then closing the display.

name: wait_vblank_count_loop
description: Waits for the display's vertical blank the requested number of times, calling a helper with a counter on each pass, and returns when the count is reached.

name: read_stream_byte_with_status
description: Reads one byte from a stream control structure through a helper, sets error or end-of-data bits in the status byte when the read fails or finds no data, and otherwise returns the byte.

name: write_byte_with_retry
description: Writes a byte from the first argument into a buffer pointed to by the second argument, using a state byte and a remaining-count field to decide when to flush, recursing when the count underflows, and setting status bits from the result.

name: allocate_stream_buffer_or_fail
description: Checks a flag in a stream control structure, calls a helper to obtain a buffer, stores its address in two fields, clears status bits and counters, and sets an error code of twelve and returns minus one when the buffer cannot be obtained.

name: dispatch_free_table_slot
description: Scans a global table of 24-byte entries for the first entry whose status byte is clear, returns zero if none is free, and otherwise passes the first two arguments and that entry to a helper and returns its result.

name: parse_command_string
description: Reads a two-character mode string, using its second character to set a mode value and a '+' option, dispatches the parsed fields to a helper, and stores the result code and a status byte into the output structure.

name: clear_object_links
description: Checks a flag byte in an object structure and, when set, calls a helper with the object's stored pointers, then clears the two link fields and the flag byte and calls a helper with a byte from the structure.

name: check_flag_and_return_pointer
description: Calls a helper when a global flag is set, and if the index is within range and its table bit is set, returns a pointer into the global table; otherwise sets an error code of nine and returns a null pointer.

name: open_file_and_set_flags
description: Finds a free table entry, writes flag bytes into it, sets an error code of twenty-four and returns minus one when no entry is free, and otherwise opens a file in a mode chosen from the flags, storing the handle in the entry and clearing the flags if the open fails.

name: clear_status_flag_and_recurse
description: Clears a status bit in the second argument, sets two other status bits, and calls the same helper again with the modified arguments while passing the first argument through unchanged.

name: read_with_error_handling
description: Obtains a file handle from a helper and reads the requested number of bytes into the buffer; on a read failure it records the I/O error code and sets an error flag, and when the length or handle is invalid it sets an error code of twenty-two and returns minus one.

name: write_handle_checked
description: Obtains a file handle from a helper, seeks to the end first when its append flag is set, writes the buffer through the DOS write call, and records an I/O error if the write fails; invalid arguments set error code twenty-two and return minus one.

name: seek_file_with_offset_table
description: Obtains a file handle, seeks to a position taken from a global offset table for an index below three, records an I/O error if that seek fails, seeks back to the start and returns the result, or sets an error code and returns minus one for an invalid handle or index.

name: close_handle_if_flag_clear
description: Looks up a file entry and returns an error when the entry is missing; if its keep-open bit is set it returns success, otherwise it closes the stored handle, clears the entry's first byte and returns success.

name: delete_file_with_error_record
description: Deletes a file through the DOS delete call; on failure it records the I/O error code, sets an error code of two and returns minus one, otherwise returns zero.

name: return_zero_value
description: Returns zero with no other effect.

name: open_file_handle
description: Opens the file named by a global structure in old-file mode and stores the returned handle in a global variable, then returns.

name: read_byte_with_pushback
description: Returns a byte previously pushed back into a global slot when one is held, clearing the slot; otherwise reads a single byte from the file handle into a stack slot and returns it.

name: read_single_byte_from_file
description: Reads one byte from the file handle stored in a global variable into a stack slot through the DOS read call, then returns that byte.

name: write_single_byte_to_file
description: Writes one byte from its argument to the file handle stored in a global variable through the DOS write call, after two global checks, and returns the byte.

name: store_pushback_byte_or_fail
description: Stores its low byte into the pushback global when that slot is empty and returns the value; if the slot already holds a byte it returns minus one without changing it.

name: store_low_byte_to_global
description: Copies the low byte of a stack argument into a global byte variable and returns.

name: close_active_handles
description: Walks a table of file entries indexed by a global count, closes each entry whose handle is set and whose keep-open bit is clear through the DOS close call, and then calls a helper with its arguments.

name: count_string_bytes
description: Scans forward from a pointer byte by byte until it reaches a zero byte, counting the bytes examined, and returns that count as the length of the string.

name: begin_io_request_if_idle
description: Decrements a pending-request counter; when the counter reaches zero, fills in the I/O request fields for a thirty-two byte transfer, starts it with the library's begin-IO call and clears the counter; it returns the decremented counter.

name: start_audio_io_request
description: If no audio request is pending, sets the request's fields for command fifteen, starts it with the audio device's begin-I/O call, and marks one request as pending.

name: start_audio_request_status
description: Starts an audio device request with command nine and sets its flag bytes when no request is pending, marks two requests pending, and returns the status value.

name: start_audio_request_byte
description: Stores its byte argument into an audio request, sets command ten with the request flag, and starts it with the audio device's begin-I/O call.

name: start_audio_request_from_argument
description: Takes a byte from an argument, stores it in an audio request with command ten and the request flag set, and starts it with the audio device's begin-I/O call.

name: poll_audio_request_done
description: Checks whether the audio requests are finished using the device's check-I/O call, returning one while a request is still in flight and zero when the chain is complete.

name: open_audio_load_samples
description: Opens the sound data file and the audio device, creates a reply port, allocates memory, and reads the sound records from the file into a table, returning a status value.

name: release_audio_device_resources
description: Waits for any outstanding audio request, deletes the reply port, closes the audio device and frees the memory allocated for the sound data.

name: setup_paula_audio_channels
description: Writes sample address, length, period and volume values into the four Paula audio channel register blocks, using stored sample addresses and fixed periods and volumes, when a flag from a helper is set.

name: decrement_paula_channel_lengths
description: Subtracts two from each of four audio channel length counters held in globals, writes each result to its channel's length register, and clamps any negative count to zero.

name: initialize_four_audio_requests
description: Fills in four audio request blocks, setting each block's command word, flag byte and data pointer to a global buffer, and links them to the same buffer, with no other side effects.

name: run_printf_format_engine
description: Walks a format string through a global stream structure, copying ordinary characters into the output and passing percent conversions to a formatting helper, then returns the number of characters produced.

name: get_next_format_byte
description: Decrements the remaining count of a global stream state, returning the next byte from the buffer when data remains and otherwise calling a refill helper.

name: flush_format_stream_state
description: Passes the global stream state to a helper that refills or flushes the buffer, then returns.

name: call_intuition_addgadget_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's add-gadget function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_clearpointer_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's clear-pointer function through the library base stored in a global table and returns.

name: call_intuition_closescreen_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's close-screen function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_closewindow_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's close-window function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_drawimage_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's draw-image function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_openscreen_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's open-screen function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_openwindow_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's open-window function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_refreshgadgets_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's refresh-gadgets function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_removegadget_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's remove-gadget function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_setpointer_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's set-pointer function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_intuition_setwindowtitles_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's set-window-titles function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_viewport_address_vector
description: Calls the graphics library's view-port address function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_autorequest_vector
description: Calls the Intuition library's auto-request function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_allocremember_vector
description: Calls the library's allocate-remember function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.

name: call_freeremember_vector
description: Calls the library's free-remember function through the library base stored in a global variable and returns.
